projects.name: My Product
projects.frame:
One paragraph, 300-400 characters: what the product is, who buys or uses it, and what about its shape changes how decisions get argued (multi-tenant, sold through a channel, an internal tool, on-premise at a customer's site).

You do not write this by hand: the setup flow drafts it by reading the repo, and proposes the product name too. It deliberately leaves out architecture, paths and features — those are readable, and the protocol already tells every participant what a roundtable decides.

`locale` is the language the agents are addressed in — match the language the personas in .claude/agents/ are written in. It is separate from the interface language, which each browser picks for itself.
